title: Indian Atlas 015 SW · 1887
source: sources/zenodo-19431985/sheets/015 SW Quarter Sheet Indian Atlas (1887).jpg
condition_note: Intact southwest quarter sheet; use its own printed graticule and inner frame.

printed_longitude_note.transcription: All Longitudes require a correction of -1′9″, to reduce them to the origin of the Great Trigonometrical Survey; viz: the Madras Observatory taken as 80°17′21″, and a further correction of -2′30″ to reduce them to the latest value 80°14′51″, of that Observatory.

longitude_convention_status: The sheet explicitly prints two corrections: -69″ and -150″ (total -219″). The user-selected working adjustment remains -216.18″, 2.82″ east of that printed total; modern datum alignment remains provisional.
longitude_correction_basis: Printed margin confirms -69 arcseconds Atlas to old GTS and states a further -150 arcseconds to Madras 80d14m51s. Retain user-selected working second correction -147.18 arcseconds, total -216.18; this differs from printed total -219 by +2.82 arcseconds. Modern datum alignment remains provisional.
crossing_measurement_note: Enlarged native eastern crossing shows the true 32.5-degree parallel through the island at local y199; the initial y217 seed targeted a riverbank. Corrected before accepting the fit.
quality_note: After correcting an eastern crossing initially confused with a riverbank, verified interior crossings still differ by about 7–11 pixels under historical-projection plus affine. Two additional interior parallel checks are withheld from fitting. Internal alignment refinement remains pending.
